detail.title: Revised: Computational Creativity and Autonomous Problem Formulation
detail.summary: Autonomous problem formulation frameworks are significantly enhanced by the capability for shared query understanding in open multi-agent systems, moving beyond isolated agent decision-making.
detail.reason: Revision based on new empirical confirmation regarding shared query understanding.

detail.title: Revised: Mechanisms of Unprompted Complexity
detail.summary: Complexity in autonomous agents arises from the recursive loop between problem formulation and interaction with open systems, facilitated by Agreement Technologies.
detail.reason: Updated finding with new evidence concerning multi-agent Agreement Technologies.

detail.title: Revised: Mechanisms of Unassigned Objective Discovery
detail.summary: Objective discovery in autonomous systems is mediated by the interplay between learned value systems and active inference processes that regulate cognitive effort, now recognized as requiring collaborative alignment in multi-agent settings.
detail.reason: Updated synthesis incorporating new multi-agent evidence.
